ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle SRT, vertex R is above, and S, W, T are on the same horizontal base. Segment RW drops perpendicularly from R to point W on base ST, and there is a right-angle mark at W. The figure marks RW = 12, WT = 9, SW = 16; beside hypotenuse RT is marked 4x + 3, and beside hypotenuse RS is marked 6x + 2. Reasoning: RT is required. Since RW is perpendicular to ST, triangle RWT is a right triangle, in which the two legs are RW = 12 and WT = 9. RT is the hypotenuse of this right triangle. By the Pythagorean theorem, RT = sqrt(12^2 + 9^2) = sqrt(144 + 81) = sqrt(225) = 15.
